page.overview:
Who is Adri Westwoode?

Adri Westwoode is a non-playable character in Final Fantasy XIV. He is a former friend of Widargelt Beake who appears in the Monk questline. Adri is one of several men behind the mask of Griffin, and assumes the identity of Theobald, the son of King Theodoric.

Adri once trained at the Temple of the Fist. He was an erstwhile prodigy who joined the ranks of the high priests when he was scarcely a man grown. Adri suffered grievous wounds in an attempt to protect Widargelt, whom he loved as a brother, amid the fiery havoc wreaked by the mad king Theodoric. Though his life was saved, his chakra were irreparably damaged. Adri was consumed by an obsession with power and a burning resentment for all those born with it. He assumed the identity of Theobald as well as the mask of the Griffin.

Once Widargelt went to Gyr Abania to try to revive the Fist of Rhalgr, Adri interrupted Widargelt's plans by claiming to be the true Griffin and that he was Theobald, the son of King Theodoric. He issued a warning against reviving the Fist of Rhalgr, and went on to reveal that Widargelt was actually his cousin Theodred. Theobald left, but not before declaring his intention to rule Ala Mhigo.

Eventually Widargelt challenged Adri to a duel. Before the fight, Adri revealed his true identity. Once the conversation was over, the battle began and it became clear that Widargelt had the advantage, and Adri summoned his minions and resorted to using imperial weaponry. Hamon showed up with Chuchuto and Rurukuta, and they entered the fray to even the odds. At the end of a long fight, Adri and his minions were defeated.
